summary_en: 230,000 shares (1.14% of S/O), up to ¥300M. Execution window Jul 16–Oct 31, 2026. Method: open-market purchase via ToSTNeT-3. Rationale: capital efficiency and shareholder returns. Total payout ratio (final dividend + buyback) projected at 70.5% of FY2026 May net income.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 15 July 2026, IG Port's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 230,000 treasury shares (1.14% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥300 million. Acquisition will proceed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using a discretionary broker arrangement (ToSTNeT-3) between 16 July 2026 and 31 October 2026. The company states the buyback is intended to enhance capital efficiency, strengthen shareholder returns, and support flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of 15 July 2026, IG Port held 175 treasury shares against a base of 20,221,425 ordinary shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Combined with the FY2026 May final dividend, the buyback is expected to deliver a total payout ratio of approximately 70.5% relative to FY2026 May parent net income.
